description: Reserved Matters Application relating to the layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping for the development of Plot 44, comprising residential units (Use Class C3) within a lower, middle and upper block ranging from ground plus 8 storeys, ground plus 13 storeys and ground plus 20 storeys (respectively) along with associated amenity space, provision for cycle storage, refuse storage and plant. The application also proposes landscaped open space, on street loading bay, and on and off street car parking alongside new footways. The application is submitted pursuant to Condition 1.3(v) and 2.1 in relation to the Phase 5D sub-phase of planning permission F/04687/13 dated 23/07/2014 (as amended) for the comprehensive mixed use redevelopment of the Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area. The application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement of Compliance.
site_name: Plot 44 Off Arbour Street,Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area.North West London NW2
